# laravelforge_site_nginx_access_log (Data Source)

Fetches the Nginx access log content for a Laravel Forge site.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the server the site runs on.
- `site_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the site.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String) Nginx access log content.
- `id` (String) Resource identifier of the Nginx access log.
